statement: Video is an introduction to world four covering only the town hub; more in-depth guides will come later.
Kill Chizoar (normal or chaotic) to get a purple gem and hand it to Carpenter Cardinal in world three town to enter world four.
World four shows four different sections which seems overwhelming but is simple to understand.
Before doing anything go to the top of the map to Gobo and do not touch any skills until prompted.
You cannot enter the portal until Gobo's roughly five-quest questline is complete; it also stops you from time gaining yourself.
Maestro skillage damage is not affected by the world four skills so there is no damage nerf.
Laboratory xp is character bound; each character must level its own stasis.
Upload characters at the top; a line starts at the prism and gets longer with level.
Upload more characters to extend the line like connect the dots; hitting squares gives account buffs and you can get multiple.
Characters uploaded to stasis cannot do any other actions; if you leave stasis the buffs go away.
A console on the other tab unlocks with levels; to be covered in a later video.
Breeding is account bound; if one character has level eight everyone is level eight.
Arena or infinite battle becomes available at breeding level eight and gives nice account rewards over time.
Eggs incubate; you choose which species to breed using one egg with a percent chance of breeding the next tier up.
Upgrade the tier-up chance through the gene splicer bought from the world four shop next to the portal; needs required breeding level.
Two known species types with multiple traits: red background is combat species and green background is forager species; white text is power level.
Forager species help you get spices for cooking.
Some spices require a combat species to hit a damage threshold to collect the spice.
Unlock spice species by doing a fight which can be attempted as many times as you like until beaten.
Ben's yard is more complicated and will be covered in a future video; still testing.
To get gray genes trash your selected species in the database; gray genes are used for upgrading stations.
For green genes equip the splicer on a character and afk in any world 1; afk rewards offer splicing genes.
Splicing genes from afk rewards destroys all materials that were rewarded in exchange for genes.
Cooking is character bound so each character levels individually; has a dining room table and a kitchen.
In the kitchen click a recipe and put one or more spices to cook a dish; it arrives at the dining table after set time.
Adding different spices shows silhouettes of possible dishes; a blacked-out one means a new dish can be discovered.
You can buy more kitchen space with in-game currency.
Dining room table shows gourmet dishes made; click the menu to see made dishes and upgrade them for specific stats.
Buy the pile of processor chips and strung jewels daily: three chips and seven strung jewels unlock later lab mechanics.
Stamps are available for purchase at the very bottom of the world four shop; pick them up.
Buy multiple splicers; you need a total of five for the next splicer upgrade and one per character if wanted.
New trapper drone and automata arm are ready to construct; upgrade them as quickly as possible.
Platinum cards are unlocked so you can farm cards after three star for better perks; also available from the gem shop.
Cards must be three star before upgrading to platinum.
There are five new alchemy bubbles for each cauldron so start brewing.
Test the new world four materials for a new vial chance.
